sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: About Qwen3.5-9B Qwen3.5-9B is Alibaba Cloud's efficient multimodal foundation model with 9B parameters, released February 2026. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Gated Attention in an 8× (3×DeltaNet→FFN→1×Attention→FFN) pattern.
